meta.description: Economic and military indicators per country, most recent non-empty value. A *Source field marks values not taken from the World Bank (IMF or drafted estimates). null = no data (the game treats it as unknown).
meta.source: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD GDP (current US$); World Bank SP.POP.TOTL Population, total; World Bank MS.MIL.TOTL.P1 Armed forces personnel, total (IISS); World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.CD Military expenditure (current US$, SIPRI); World Bank GOV_WGI_PV.EST Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism: Estimate (WGI). World Bank Open Data is licensed CC BY 4.0. Gaps: tools/countries/estimates.json.
